    function strip_tags(str, allowed_tags) {
    var key = '', allowed = false;
    var matches = [];
    var allowed_array = [];
    var allowed_tag = '';
    var i = 0;
    var k = '';
    var html = '';

    var replacer = function (search, replace, str) {
    return str.split(search).join(replace);
    };
    // Build allowes tags associative array
    if (allowed_tags) {
    allowed_array = allowed_tags.match(/([a-zA-Z0-9]+)/gi);
    }

    str += '';

    // Match tags
    matches = str.match(/(<\/?[\S][^>]*>)/gi);

    // Go through all HTML tags
    for (key in matches) {
    if (isNaN(key)) {
    // IE7 Hack
    continue;
    }

    // Save HTML tag
    html = matches[key].toString();

    // Is tag not in allowed list ? Remove from str !
    allowed = false;

    // Go through all allowed tags
    for (k in allowed_array) {
    // Init
    allowed_tag = allowed_array[k];
    i = -1;

    if (i !== 0) {
    i = html.toLowerCase().indexOf('<' + allowed_tag + '>');
    }
    if (i !== 0) {
    i = html.toLowerCase().indexOf('<' + allowed_tag + ' ');
    }
    if (i !== 0) {
    i = html.toLowerCase().indexOf('</' + allowed_tag);
    }

    // Determine
    if (i === 0) {
    allowed = true;
    break;
    }
    }

    if (!allowed) {
    str = replacer(html, "", str);
    // Custom replace. No regexing
    }
    }

    return str;
    }

/* Line Spacing */

    line-height: 1.8;
}

.asw-linespacing-extra-wide * {
    line-height: 2;
}

.asw-linespacing-narrow * {
    line-height: 1;
}

/*Letter Spacing*/
.accesspro {
    letter-spacing: normal !important;
    line-height: normal !important;
}

.asw-letterspacing-wide * {
    letter-spacing: 0.1em !important;
}

.asw-letterspacing-extra-wide * {
    letter-spacing: 0.2em !important;
}

.asw-letterspacing-narrow * {
    letter-spacing: -0.1em !important;
}

/*Font Weight*/
.asw-fontweight-800 {
    font-weight: 800 !important;
}

/*Text Alignment*/
.asw-textalignment-center * {
    text-align: center !important;
}

.asw-textalignment-left * {
    text-align: left !important;
}

.asw-textalignment-right * {
    text-align: right !important;
}

/* Contrast */
.asw-contrastmode-dark {
    background-color: #000 !important;
    color: #fff !important;
}

.asw-contrastmode-dark * {
    background-color: transparent;
    background-image: none;
    color: #fff !important;
}

.asw-contrastmode-light {
    background-color: #fff !important;
    color: #000 !important;
}

.asw-contrastmode-high {
    background-color: #000 !important;
    color: #fff !important;
}

/* Stop Animation */
.asw-stop-animation * {
    transition: none !important;
    animation-fill-mode: forwards !important;
    animation-iteration-count: 1 !important;
    animation-duration: 10ms !important;
}

    transform: translateY(-100%) translateX(-100%);
    left: 0;
    background: var(--acp-color-contentbg);
    color: var(--acp-color-contentfg);
    border-radius: 4px;
    padding: 4px;
    width: 100%;
}

.acp-widget-small .acp-report-a-problem:hover .acp-report-a-problem-tooltip,
.acp-widget-small .acp-report-a-problem:focus-visible .acp-report-a-problem-tooltip {
    display: block;
}

.acp-widget-small .acp-report-a-problem-icon svg {
    display: flex;
}

.asw-menu--default .acp-report-a-problem-text,
.asw-menu--compact .acp-report-a-problem-text {
    display: flex;
}

.acp-widget-large .acp-compliance-reset--footer .acp-report-a-problem-text,
.acp-widget-larger .acp-compliance-reset--footer .acp-report-a-problem-text,
.acp-widget-large .acp-compliance-reset--footer .acp-compliance,
.acp-widget-larger .acp-compliance-reset--footer .acp-compliance {
    font-size: 16px !important;
}

@media screen and (max-width: 400px) {
    .acp-report-a-problem-text {
        display: none;
    }

    .acp-report-a-problem {
        position: relative;
    }

    .acp-report-a-problem:hover .acp-report-a-problem-tooltip,
    .acp-report-a-problem:focus-visible .acp-report-a-problem-tooltip {
        display: block;
    }

    .asw-menu--default .acp-report-a-problem-text,
    .asw-menu--compact .acp-report-a-problem-text {
        display: flex;
    }
}

@media screen and (min-width: 400px) {
    .acp-report-a-problem-icon svg {
        display: none;
    }
}

.acp-language-loading-spinner {
    width: 16px;
    height: 16px;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    border: 2px solid var(--acp-color-buttonfg);
    border-top: 2px solid transparent;
    border-radius: 50%;
    animation: acp-spin 1s linear infinite;
    margin-left: 45px;
}

@keyframes acp-spin {
    0% {
        transform: rotate(0deg);
    }

    100% {
        transform: rotate(360deg);
    }
}

/* Virtual Keyboard Custom Button Styles */
.simple-keyboard .hg-small-key {
    max-width: 60px !important;
    flex-grow: 0.5 !important;
}

.simple-keyboard .hg-large-space {
    max-width: none !important;
    flex-grow: 3 !important;
}

/* Mobile responsiveness for screens 425px or smaller */
@media screen and (max-width: 425px) {
    #acp-widget {
        max-width: 350px !important;
        width: 350px !important;
    }
    
    #acp-widget.acp-widget-small,
    #acp-widget.acp-widget-large,
    #acp-widget.acp-widget-larger {
        max-width: 350px !important;
        width: 350px !important;
    }

    /* Override larger widget font sizes for mobile */
    .acp-widget-larger .accesspro *,
    .acp-widget-large .accesspro * {
        font-size: 13px !important;
    }

    /* Smaller font sizes for mobile */
    #acp-widget .acp-widget-title {
        font-size: 13px !important;
    }

    #acp-widget .acp-feature-item,
    #acp-widget .acp-profile-button {
        font-size: 13px !important;
    }

    #acp-widget .acp-collapsible-title {
        font-size: 14px !important;
    }
}

/* Extra small mobile screens (320px and smaller) */
@media screen and (max-width: 320px) {
    #acp-widget {
        max-width: 300px !important;
        width: 300px !important;
    }
    
    #acp-widget.acp-widget-small,
    #acp-widget.acp-widget-large,
    #acp-widget.acp-widget-larger {
        max-width: 300px !important;
        width: 300px !important;
    }

    /* Even smaller font sizes for very small screens */
    #acp-widget .acp-widget-title {
        font-size: 14px !important;
    }

    #acp-widget .acp-feature-item,
    #acp-widget .acp-profile-button {
        font-size: 12px !important;
    }

    #acp-widget .acp-collapsible-title {
        font-size: 13px !important;
    }

    #acp-widget .acp-compliance,
    #acp-widget .acp-reset-text {
        font-size: 11px !important;
    }
}

					<h1>GPS Showing Inaccurate Location on Meshtastic Devices (WisMesh Tag, Pocket, T-Deck, etc.)</h1>
				</div>
				<div class="page-content-width rte">
					<p data-start="192" data-end="411">If your Meshtastic device is reporting an incorrect GPS position or only showing an approximate location, the issue may be related to the <strong data-start="319" data-end="349">Location Precision setting</strong> not saving correctly in the Meshtastic app—especially on iOS.</p>
<h3 data-start="413" data-end="429"><strong data-start="417" data-end="429">Symptoms</strong></h3>
<ul data-start="430" data-end="619">
<li data-start="430" data-end="466">
<p data-start="432" data-end="466">GPS appears offset or inaccurate</p>
</li>
<li data-start="467" data-end="554">
<p data-start="469" data-end="554">App shows “Precise location enabled,” but device reports a much further approximate radius</p>
</li>
<li data-start="555" data-end="619">
<p data-start="557" data-end="619">Changing the setting on the phone does not update the device</p>
</li>
</ul>
<h3 data-start="621" data-end="645"><strong data-start="625" data-end="645">Resolution Steps</strong></h3>
<ol data-start="646" data-end="1213">
<li data-start="646" data-end="809">
<p data-start="649" data-end="687"><strong data-start="649" data-end="687">Disable Location in the Mobile App</strong></p>
<ul data-start="691" data-end="809">
<li data-start="691" data-end="736">
<p data-start="693" data-end="736">Open the Meshtastic app (iOS or Android).</p>
</li>
<li data-start="740" data-end="781">
<p data-start="742" data-end="781">Go to <strong data-start="748" data-end="778">Device Settings → Position</strong>.</p>
</li>
<li data-start="785" data-end="809">
<p data-start="787" data-end="809">Turn <strong data-start="792" data-end="804">Location</strong> OFF.</p>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li data-start="811" data-end="1125">
<p data-start="814" data-end="869"><strong data-start="814" data-end="869">Use the Web Interface to Re-Enable Precise Location</strong></p>
<ul data-start="873" data-end="1125">
<li data-start="873" data-end="906">
<p data-start="875" data-end="906">Plug the device into your PC.</p>
</li>
<li data-start="910" data-end="1000">
<p data-start="912" data-end="1000">Open the Meshtastic Web UI </p>
</li>
<li data-start="1004" data-end="1051">
<p data-start="1006" data-end="1051">Navigate to <strong data-start="1018" data-end="1048">Device Settings → Position</strong>.</p>
</li>
<li data-start="1055" data-end="1102">
<p data-start="1057" data-end="1102">Set <strong data-start="1061" data-end="1078">Location Mode</strong> to <strong data-start="1082" data-end="1099">Precise (GPS)</strong>.</p>
</li>
<li data-start="1106" data-end="1125">
<p data-start="1108" data-end="1125">Save the setting.</p>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li data-start="1127" data-end="1213">
<p data-start="1130" data-end="1151"><strong data-start="1130" data-end="1151">Reboot the Device</strong></p>
<ul data-start="1155" data-end="1213">
<li data-start="1155" data-end="1213">
<p data-start="1157" data-end="1213">Power-cycle or reset the device to ensure changes apply.</p>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ol>
<h3 data-start="1215" data-end="1237"><strong data-start="1219" data-end="1237">Why This Works</strong></h3>
<p data-start="1238" data-end="1416">Some iOS app versions may display the precision setting incorrectly or fail to save changes. Updating it from the PC/Web UI ensures the device receives the correct configuration.</p>
<h3 data-start="1418" data-end="1452"><strong data-start="1422" data-end="1452">If GPS Is Still Inaccurate</strong></h3>
<ul data-start="1453" data-end="1633">
<li data-start="1453" data-end="1535">
<p data-start="1455" data-end="1535">Move outdoors with clear sky view for initial lock (may take several minutes).</p>
</li>
<li data-start="1536" data-end="1597">
<p data-start="1538" data-end="1597">Ensure the antenna or device orientation is unobstructed.</p>
</li>
<li data-start="1598" data-end="1633">
<p data-start="1600" data-end="1633">Confirm firmware is up to date.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p data-start="1635" data-end="1709">If issues persist, contact Rokland Support for additional troubleshooting.</p>

  <script>
    function makeDraggableVirtualKeyboard(el) {
      let pos1 = 0,
        pos2 = 0,
        pos3 = 0,
        pos4 = 0;

      el.onmousedown = dragMouseDown;

      function dragMouseDown(e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        pos3 = e.clientX;
        pos4 = e.clientY;
        document.onmouseup = closeDragElement;
        document.onmousemove = elementDrag;
      }

      function elementDrag(e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        pos1 = pos3 - e.clientX;
        pos2 = pos4 - e.clientY;
        pos3 = e.clientX;
        pos4 = e.clientY;
        el.style.top = el.offsetTop - pos2 + 'px';
        el.style.left = el.offsetLeft - pos1 + 'px';
        el.style.bottom = 'unset';
        el.style.right = 'unset';
      }

      function closeDragElement() {
        document.onmouseup = null;
        document.onmousemove = null;
      }
    }

    makeDraggableVirtualKeyboard(document.getElementById('acp-virtualKeyboardPopup'));
  </script>
